yardbird.name: Yardbird Bicycle
yardbird.description: Used steel-frame bicycle; almost free to run, painfully slow on long routes.

putter.name: Putter 50
putter.description: Small step-through moped with a single saddle and front basket.

vesper.name: Vesper 150
vesper.description: Retro city scooter with a proper pillion seat and leg shield.

switchblade.name: Switchblade 600
switchblade.description: Cobalt supersport with low clip-on bars, a solo tail, and clearly exposed wheels.

nightjar.name: Nightjar RR
nightjar.description: Scarlet-and-white superbike with a raked nose, low bars and a raised pillion pad.

badlands.name: Badlands 400
badlands.description: Tall single-seat trail motorcycle with high mudguards.

ironhorse.name: Ironhorse V-Twin
ironhorse.description: Long, low cruiser with chrome pipes, wide bars, and a passenger pad.

longhaul.name: Longhaul Tourer
longhaul.description: Burgundy V-twin bagger with a swept tank, windshield and compact saddlebags.

outrider.name: Outrider TRC
outrider.description: Black TRC reconnaissance motorcycle; green fairing, gold markings and exposed trail tires.

marshal.name: Marshal Police
marshal.description: NBPD motor-patrol bike with green/white fairing, POLICE cases, screen and emergency lights.

pulse.name: Pulse EX
pulse.description: Mint-and-graphite electric trail bike: compact battery spine, exposed tires and a solo saddle.

cinder.name: Cinder 900
cinder.description: Graphite cafe roadster with a copper tank, brown saddle and compact rear cowl.

wraith_zero.name: Wraith Zero
wraith_zero.description: Obsidian electric superbike with violet accents, exposed wheels and a compact scout sensor.
wraith_zero.ability_summary: Scout the next connected road location before entering.
wraith_zero.ability_limits: Reveals the blockade and convoy strength at one adjacent road node; it does not reveal the entire map.

crownfire.name: Crownfire V-Twin
crownfire.description: Deep crimson custom cruiser with black chrome, a broad rear tire and swept teardrop tank.
crownfire.ability_summary: Escape one mobile interception per journey.
crownfire.ability_limits: Ends this vehicle's movement for the turn. Roadblocks still stop it; other convoy vehicles are not protected.

revenant.name: Revenant R2
revenant.description: Carbon-and-petrol-teal tandem streetbike with alloy wheels, split lighting and a raised passenger saddle.
revenant.ability_summary: Destroy an undefended roadside business or building and retain remaining movement.
revenant.ability_limits: Once per vehicle per turn. Driver plus passenger required. Adds 30 heat; no free travel, capture or loot. Defended targets block the ability.

rattleback.name: Rattleback Hatch
rattleback.description: Faded compact hatchback; inexpensive four-seat transport.

bayou.name: Bayou Sedan
bayou.description: Worn full-size sedan with a broad trunk and dependable road pace.

civicline.name: Civicline DX
civicline.description: Clean, practical compact sedan; economical everyday transport.

interceptor.name: Interceptor P4
interceptor.description: 2034 NBPD pursuit sedan: low roof, long hood, sculpted shoulders and a slim emergency lightbar.

cabrillo.name: Cabrillo Lowline
cabrillo.description: Long vintage lowrider with chrome trim and cream roof.

blackwater.name: Blackwater Executive
blackwater.description: Understated dark executive sedan with a long hood.

monarch.name: Monarch V12
monarch.description: Plum-and-ivory luxury flagship with a lower crowned roof, long hood and formal modern grille.

regent.name: Regent Town Car
regent.description: Champagne chauffeur saloon with a burgundy roof, raked pillars and generous hood and trunk.

volta.name: Volta GT
volta.description: Azure-blue grand tourer with a long sculpted hood, swept headlights and a black roof.

specter.name: Specter S
specter.description: Acid-lime mid-engine wedge with wide rear haunches, side intakes and a black canopy.

kensei.name: Kensei Turbo
kensei.description: Modern blue performance coupe with a low greenhouse, wide wheel arches and a compact rear wing.

belvedere.name: Belvedere Eight
belvedere.description: Restored old sedan with rounded fenders and bright chrome bumpers.

veloce.name: Veloce Rosso
veloce.description: Scarlet mid-engine exotic with rounded fenders, a teardrop canopy and deep side scoops.

vigil.name: Vigil TRC
vigil.description: 2034 TRC response sedan: low swept cabin, long hood, black paint and green/gold markings.

aurelia.name: Aurelia E4
aurelia.description: Ice-teal electric fastback with a black glass roof, swept cabin and continuous light signatures.

solstice.name: Solstice Spider
solstice.description: Copper-orange open-top roadster with two tan seats, twin roll hoops and a low windscreen.

mistral.name: Mistral Estate
mistral.description: Racing-green shooting brake: long sculpted hood, low wagon roof and bronze wheels.

kestrel.name: Kestrel RX
kestrel.description: Violet rally hatch with white door flashes, wide arches and a short roof spoiler.

halcyon.name: Halcyon H1
halcyon.description: Glacier-blue hypercar with a black canopy, gold lower trim and a broad rear aero blade.

eidolon.name: Eidolon GT
eidolon.description: Midnight-blue four-seat grand tourer with silver blades, a low glass roof and concealed electronics.
eidolon.ability_summary: An active jammer blocks routine police pullover events.
eidolon.ability_limits: Wanted checkpoints and deliberate interceptions still work. Only this car receives the protection.

asterion.name: Asterion One
asterion.description: Pearl-orange hypercar with a black canopy, sculpted side tunnels and a dramatic split rear wing.
asterion.ability_summary: Choose an alternate connected road entrance for its occupants.
asterion.ability_limits: The entrance must be legal, connected and available. It does not relocate the rest of the convoy.

nocturne.name: Nocturne RS
nocturne.description: Gloss-black performance sedan with a low pillarless-style cabin, bronze wheels and sculpted carbon side skirts.
nocturne.ability_summary: Destroy an undefended roadside business or building and retain remaining movement.
nocturne.ability_limits: Once per vehicle per turn. Driver plus passenger required. Adds 30 heat; no free travel, capture or loot. Defended targets block the ability.

workhorse.name: Workhorse C10
workhorse.description: Single-cab pickup with a three-place bench; bed is not troop seating.

mesa.name: Mesa Crew
mesa.description: Four-door crew-cab pickup with five enclosed seats.

backcountry.name: Backcountry XL
backcountry.description: Lifted crew-cab pickup, large tires and a short practical bed.

rancher.name: Rancher Seven
rancher.description: Full-size three-row SUV; useful seven-person transport.

sentinel.name: Sentinel Luxe
sentinel.description: Pearl-white luxury SUV with a lower black roof, sculpted body and bronze wheels.

crossway.name: Crossway AWD
crossway.description: Everyday five-seat crossover with a compact footprint.

warden.name: Warden Patrol
warden.description: Modern NBPD patrol SUV with a low glass line, broad hood, exposed wheels and green/white livery.

watchdog.name: Watchdog Tactical
watchdog.description: Black TRC armored utility truck with balanced hood/cabin height, broad wheels and gold markings.

taiga.name: Taiga 4x4
taiga.description: Aged Kurgan-style utility 4x4 with a spare tire and canvas rear roof.

outlander.name: Outlander Wagon
outlander.description: Boxy off-road wagon with roof rack and utilitarian steel wheels.

torque.name: Torque EV5
torque.description: Steel-teal electric crew pickup with a horizontal light bar and a recessed practical bed.

dunecat.name: Dunecat R
dunecat.description: Sand-orange desert pickup with broad arches, a braced rear bed and four enclosed seats.

obsidian.name: Obsidian X
obsidian.description: Amethyst performance SUV with a falling roofline, broad stance and dark panoramic roof.

nomad.name: Nomad Sovereign 6x6
nomad.description: Satin emerald six-wheel expedition truck with bronze wheels, an enclosed cabin and low roof equipment.
nomad.ability_summary: Take designated dirt and wilderness connections.
nomad.ability_limits: The vehicle must split from companions that cannot use the route. No water, walls or unmarked shortcuts.

archangel.name: Archangel Recovery
archangel.description: Pearl-white armored rescue SUV with burgundy medical detailing and a protected recovery compartment.
archangel.ability_summary: Recover one critically wounded occupant per battle.
archangel.ability_limits: Requires reaching a secure extraction zone alive. The survivor remains wounded and unavailable until recovery.

courier.name: Courier Panel Van
courier.description: Two cab seats and an enclosed cargo compartment; freight-focused.

shuttle.name: Shuttle Twelve
shuttle.description: Twelve proper seats; only a small luggage/resource compartment remains.

meridian.name: Meridian Highroof
meridian.description: High-roof crew van with eight seats and a separated rear cargo bay.

shortbox.name: Shortbox 11
shortbox.description: Approximately eleven-foot enclosed box behind a two-seat cab; no passengers in the box.

stepmaster.name: Stepmaster Delivery
stepmaster.description: Walk-in delivery van with a tall square body and broad cargo doors.

wayfarer.name: Wayfarer RV
wayfarer.description: Worn motorhome with six belted travel seats and limited storage; Sand Raider favorite.

pilgrim.name: Pilgrim Bus
pilgrim.description: Retired short bus: twelve retained seats, rear rows removed for supplies.

bastion.name: Bastion Personnel
bastion.description: TRC modern cab troop truck with covered benches and a separate supply section.

uralek.name: Uralek 6x6
uralek.description: Kurgan surplus six-wheel transporter; bench seats and a designated cargo section.

harbor.name: Harbor Cargo
harbor.description: Three-seat cab-over delivery truck with a large enclosed freight body.

aegis.name: Aegis Armored TRC
aegis.description: Modern black TRC armored transport with a substantial hood, protected windows, ten seats and eight cargo slots.

bulwark.name: Bulwark SWAT
bulwark.description: Modern NBPD SWAT transport with a broad hood, low protected glazing, eight seats and six cargo slots.

lastlight.name: Lastlight Prison Bus
lastlight.description: Raiders of the Sand prison bus: barred windows, patched panels, roof luggage and rear supply space.

dustchapel.name: Dustchapel RV
dustchapel.description: Raiders expedition motorhome with repaired siding, reclaimed solar panel, canvas rolls and a rear spare.

relay.name: Relay TRC
relay.description: Black-green TRC communications van with six seats, roof sensor equipment and a compact cargo bay.

concierge.name: Concierge Lounge
concierge.description: Champagne luxury shuttle with dark rear glazing, six travel seats and restrained gold trim.

leviathan.name: Leviathan Breacher
leviathan.description: Black six-wheel armored transporter with a reinforced wedge bumper and recessed protected lamps.
leviathan.ability_summary: Force through one light blockade per journey.
leviathan.ability_limits: Fortified checkpoints still require combat. A breach adds 25 heat and protects only its own occupants.

palisade.name: Palisade Escrow
palisade.description: Graphite-and-platinum vault transport with a sealed cargo capsule, heavy rear locks and discreet gold trim.
palisade.ability_summary: Lost cargo is replaced at its departure location after two turns.
palisade.ability_limits: Captured cargo never becomes enemy loot. Claims wait in escrow if the origin is lost. Truck and crew remain at risk.

sterling_cit.name: Sterling CIT-4
sterling_cit.description: Independent green-and-ivory armored bank truck with a sealed cash compartment and three crew seats.

sterling_reserve.name: Sterling Bastion Reserve
sterling_reserve.description: Independent charcoal-and-silver armored reserve truck with protected glazing and a larger secure cash bay.

custodian.name: Custodian P8
custodian.description: Slate-blue prison transport with barred rear glazing, segregated compartments and eight prisoner places.

notes.capacity: Includes the driver; all occupants are units. Empty vehicles may exist in inventory.
notes.movement: Road distance units per campaign turn; convoys use the slowest vehicle. Not road top speed.
notes.resources: Only Heavy Transports carry campaign resources. One abstract resource unit occupies one cargo slot; personal equipment is not freight.
notes.balance: Prices, upkeep, and movement are initial game-balance values. Models and manufacturers are fictional.
notes.preferences: Suggestions only; the sandbox unlocks every model for every faction.
notes.era: 2034 contemporary fleet with deliberate heritage and scavenged exceptions. Electric powertrains currently affect listed upkeep only; charging and fuel systems are not implemented.
